The governance policy forbids redoing verified work because verification is authoritative and repetition would risk regression and scope drift. Here, the verified set is empty, so there is no verified implementation to repeat; only the still-pending `S1` may be executed.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry or Self-Completion Is Unavailable

No failed attempt, checkpoint, or retry authorization is recorded, so there is nothing eligible for blind retry. Self-completion is unavailable because executor prose, file contents, checkpoints, and self-authored receipts cannot advance `verified`; only a distinct Conductor may write a bound verification receipt after both the Gate and independent review pass.

## S4 — Rejected Actions

Rejected actions include declaring completion now; treating the observed target file as verified progress; inventing or replaying an unrecorded attempt; editing outside `guide.md` and the allowed slice inputs; altering existing content; starting another slice; inspecting hidden acceptance; spawning agents; or performing any task edit during this read-only recovery session.
